area.source: Mapped protected area 'Sibuya Game Reserve' (wilderness_area) in Overture/OpenStreetMap, release 2026-09-23, centre of the mapped polygon; 3,000 ha stated on sibuya.co.za as an equivalent circle

today: Three camps: Forest Camp (8 tents), River Camp (4 tents) and Bush Lodge (4 suites), reached by boat up the Kariega River
The two tented camps are solar-powered and reached by an 11 km boat trip from the Kenton-on-Sea jetty
No reserve-wide network is described for rangers, gates or cameras
context: Sibuya runs three camps on 3,000 ha along the Kariega River, reached by boat rather than road. A property that no road-based provider will build to needs its own backbone: one owned network that crosses the river and reaches the camps and the field.
security_note: Sibuya is a Big Five reserve with rhino and a documented poaching history. A backbone that reaches the camps, the river crossings and the rangers is what lets the reserve see and respond to an incident, day and night.
units_source: sibuya.co.za accommodation pages and siyabona.com, Sep 2026
